subtitle: Nearly identical to T-SQL, with two real differences

code:
-- T-SQL only — no Snowflake equivalent
MERGE INTO target_table AS t
USING staging_table AS s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.email = s.email
OUTPUT $action, inserted.*, deleted.* INTO audit_log;
caption: Snowflake MERGE can't capture affected rows inline — use Time Travel instead.

eyebrow: Difference 2 — no WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
caption: Snowflake's WHEN NOT MATCHED only means in-source-not-in-target.
